decisions.reason: Although it has faded from website visibility, this encrypted secondary channel remains close to the firm's core secure communication strategy, so sunk development effort and strategic fit still favor continuation.
The mobile PDF signature function supports the firm's announced push into app-based interactions and online signing, making management inclined to keep backing it despite weaker recent visibility.
As a multi-layer end-to-end security architecture rooted in the firm's technical core, it likely embodies substantial R&D commitment that strongly supports persistence.

The QR-code-based hardware token is the least aligned with the firm's broader software-led ecosystem direction, and with reduced public emphasis management is now more likely to discontinue it and redeploy resources.

The payment network security compliance suite still fits the firm's security and regulatory capabilities, so prior investment and the tendency to justify earlier commitments make withdrawal less likely than continuation.
